mapper.insert: insert into kb_async_tasks(task_code, profile_code, protocol, upstream_task_id, status, attempts, next_poll_at, claim_id, claim_expires_at, last_polled_at, request_json, poll_spec_json, context_json, result_json, error_code, error_message, billing_rule_code, billing_rule_version_code, submitted_at, completed_at, expires_at, result_expires_at, callback_url, delivery_status, delivery_attempts) values(#{taskCode}, #{profileCode}, #{protocol}, #{upstreamTaskId}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{nextPollAt}, #{claimId}, #{claimExpiresAt}, #{lastPolledAt}, #{requestJson}, #{pollSpecJson}, #{contextJson}, #{resultJson}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{billingRuleCode}, #{billingRuleVersionCode}, #{submittedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{resultExpiresAt}, #{callbackUrl}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{deliveryAttempts})
mapper.update: update kb_async_tasks set claim_id = #{claimId}, claim_expires_at = #{claimExpires}, last_polled_at = now(3) where status in and next_poll_at <= now(3) and expires_at > now(3) and (claim_id is null or claim_expires_at < now(3)) order by next_poll_at asc limit #{limit}

update kb_async_tasks set status = #{nextStatus}, attempts = attempts + 1, next_poll_at = #{nextPollAt}, last_polled_at = #{lastPolledAt}, claim_id = null, claim_expires_at = null where id = #{id} and claim_id = #{claimId} and status in
